# circuitRF OUTPUT for brief-sar-9's superposition gate — not a reference

`Pair PerPort.openems.s2p`, its `_em.npy`, its `.cemr` and its `.fields` folder are what `circuitrf em ../Pair/3d/Pair.c3d --setup PerPort` wrote. `simultaneous/` is one openEMS run of port 1's model with port 2's excitation added at -0.5 times its own (PairSuperpositionRerunTests): its E and H on the field set's cells (complex64, as solved) and the incident waves its own probes measured at the two ports (√W as solved, the field set's power-wave convention). PairSuperpositionTests recombines the field set with those waves and holds the result to the simultaneous run's local SAR and B1+ in every cell.
